title: How Effectively Can BERT Models Interpret Context and Detect Bengali Communal Violent Text?
reasoning: The paper specifically benchmarks and evaluates the ability of BERT-based models to detect communal violent text, focusing on religious categories (Religio Communal) and religious terminology (e.g., Islam, Allah, Hindu, Atheist). It analyzes how model embeddings handle these religious contexts and identify potential biases or failures in distinguishing communal from non-communal religious content.
